skill.name: X Author Latest Posts Collector

userIds.title: X user ID / @handle
userIds.description: By default, collects posts from Elon Musk (44196397). Supports numeric user IDs, @handles, and X/Twitter profile URLs; up to 10 targets separated by commas, semicolons, or line breaks. Any input overrides the default.

maxTweetsPerUser.title: Latest posts per user (1–50)
maxTweetsPerUser.description: Maximum number of latest posts to save for each target user.

includeRetweets.title: Include retweets
includeRetweets.description: Off by default; when enabled, visible retweets in the timeline are also saved.

fields.label: X user ID / @handle (default: Elon Musk)
fields.description: Default target is Elon Musk (44196397). Supports multiple targets; entered values override the default.

fields.label: Latest posts per user (1–50)
fields.description: Maximum number of latest posts to save for each target user.

fields.label: Include retweets
fields.description: Off by default; when enabled, visible retweets in the timeline are also saved.

metadata.description: Uses the signed-in X account to open each target profile timeline, collect the latest posts by publication time, attempt to expand long posts and verify user identity, then save posts to the Tobub content database and SQLite/JSONL dataset. The default target is Elon Musk (user ID 44196397); multiple targets can be collected in one run.
